record.question: As per _________, no police officer shall be eligible to be appointed as an Assistant Public Prosecutor, if he— (A) has taken any part in the investigation into the offence with respect to which the accused is being prosecuted; or (B) is below the rank of Inspector.
record.explanation: BNSS Section 19 disqualifies police officers who participated in investigation or are below inspector rank from serving as Assistant Public Prosecutor.
